comments.body:
Changes LGTM, was there an issue associated with this, or did you eagle-eye just spot it?  

A short description of the reasoning for the change would be good ot add for historical purposes.   Something like:

Non-ASCII event JSON could be undercounted, so rotation could fire after the configured `events_logfile_size` was already exceeded. Now use `len(content)` so the check matches the bytes that will be written.

or some such
